13.text: The crowd's energy was very mixed. Some of them were cheering, some of them were curious, some of them were disapproving.

16.speaker: Narrator
16.text: I had gathered nearly all of the nobles in Rizia to witness today's events. Many were in a party mood, having drinks and enjoying themselves.

21.text: I was escorted by many police as I made my way into the age-old execution chamber. The air was damp inside and the place was a little unclean for my taste.

22.speaker: Narrator

23.speaker: Narrator

66.speaker: Narrator
66.text: The executioner walked in after signalling the officers to leave. He was a short, pudgy-looking man. Nothing about him gave away the idea that his job was to kill people.

67.speaker: Narrator
67.text: He had an emotionless face, as if this was just a regular day for him. The same face a clerk would make when processing their taxes.

68.speaker: Narrator
68.text: An involuntary shiver ran down my spine.

69.speaker: Narrator
69.text: Calmly he came before me and bowed, waiting for my instructions.

70.speaker: Player_Romus
70.text: "I would like to speak to the death row inmates."

73.speaker: Narrator

74.speaker: Narrator
74.text: He pulled the black bags off each inmate's head to reveal their faces.

119.speaker: Player_Romus
119.text: "I won't waste my breath on you people anymore."
119.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Executions_AllOfYou"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Executions_Axel"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Executions_Lucita"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Executions_Manus"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Executions_Rico"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Executions_Rusty"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Executions_Sal"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Executions_Taddeus"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Executions_Pabel"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Executions_Titus"] == true

120.speaker: Player_Romus
120.text: "You will all be forgotten. I will remove you from the annals of history."

121.speaker: Player_Romus
121.text: "You have committed grave crimes against Rizia. I hereby punish you."

122.speaker: Player_Romus
122.text: "I am only doing my royal duty as the King of Rizia. I hope you will use these last moments to repent."

123.speaker: Player_Romus
123.text: "I have been waiting for this for a long time. I will savor every second of it."

124.speaker: Player_Romus
124.text: "The destiny of our countries has always been to be together. Yet, here we are."

125.speaker: Player_Romus
125.text: "I will personally make sure your remains are transported back to your relatives in Pales."

126.speaker: Player_Romus
126.text: "Maybe now you will finally get to meet your dear God."

127.speaker: Player_Romus
127.text: "You will burn in hell for an eternity for what you have done."

128.speaker: Player_Romus
128.text: "It is truly sad to see a once-godly man indulge in such crimes against the crown."

130.speaker: Player_Romus
130.text: "You share the fate of your father. Perhaps it is true that nothing good comes out of House Sazon."

131.speaker: Player_Romus
131.text: "Once the heir of a great family. Now look at what your dynasty has come to."

132.speaker: Player_Romus
132.text: "Your gold will not save you now."

133.speaker: Player_Romus
133.text: "Your endless greed has ended you. Ironic."

134.speaker: Player_Romus
134.text: "This shouldn't have been your demise. I am disappointed."

136.speaker: Player_Romus
136.text: "It pains me to do this to a member of my own family, but your incompetence and treason have left me with no choice."

137.speaker: Player_Romus
137.text: "You dared to betray your King. The leader of your own House! You deserve this."

139.speaker: Player_Romus
139.text: "House Azaro will fall because of you."

140.speaker: Player_Romus
140.text: "If only I could execute you twice."

141.speaker: Player_Romus
141.text: "From a great general to a death row inmate. What a sorry sight."

142.speaker: Player_Romus
142.text: "My father should have executed you long ago. Perhaps none of this would have happened."

143.speaker: Player_Romus
143.text: "The only thing you have brought to your family is shame."

144.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
144.text: "I accept my fate, Your Majesty. I apologize for failing you and this kingdom."

145.speaker: Narrator
145.text: She stared at me, every muscle in her body practically vibrating with constrained rage.

146.speaker: Rico Toras
146.text: "Shut up and get it over with, cousin."

147.speaker: Russello Montoro
147.text: "You're making a mistake, Your Majesty. Do you know the fortune that awaits you if you let me go? We could make billions together!"

148.speaker: Manus Sazon
148.text: "Your time will come as well, King Romus. This will only fuel the people's rage."

149.speaker: Sal Ignacius
149.text: "Curse you and your family, Romus the First. You deserve to die the same death that your father did."

151.speaker: Narrator
151.text: He fell on his knees on the ground. The guards helped him up on his feet again.

154.speaker: Narrator
154.text: On seeing my impassive face, he abruptly assumed a pleading tone.

155.speaker: Narrator
155.text: He did not dare look into my eyes.

156.speaker: Narrator
156.text: The venom in her voice almost made me take a step back.

166.speaker: Narrator
166.text: The executioner looked at me for the final order.

167.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
167.text: Gesture for the executions to start.

168.speaker: Narrator
168.text: With an off-putting smile, he moved over to the line. The guards followed his lead.

178.speaker: Narrator
178.text: Soon after, all of them were tied to the electric chairs.

179.speaker: Narrator
179.text: Their heads were shaved and wetted with a sponge dipped in a bucket of water.

180.speaker: Narrator
180.text: Soon after, all of them were tied to the poles.

182.speaker: Narrator
182.text: Soon after, all of them kneeling under the sharp blade of the guillotine.
182.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Executions_Method_Electrocution"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Executions_Method_FiringSquad"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Executions_Method_Guillotine"] == true)

183.speaker: Narrator
183.text: They could not even look up to see.

184.speaker: Narrator
184.text: Soon after, all of them were on the gallows with ropes around their necks.
184.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Executions_Method_Electrocution"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Executions_Method_FiringSquad"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Executions_Method_Guillotine"] == true) == false)

186.speaker: Narrator
186.text: Their final rites were read to them as well as prayers for the ones who requested it.

187.speaker: Narrator
187.text: The executioner held his hand up to signal.

188.speaker: Player_Romus
188.text: "I will see you all in hell."

200.speaker: Narrator
200.text: His hand went down and the signal was given.

201.speaker: Narrator
201.text: The lever was turned all the way up and the voltage was increased to maximum. A terrible smell filled the air.

203.speaker: Narrator
203.text: The firing squad loaded their rifles, pointed and shot at the prisoners in unison.

204.speaker: Narrator
204.text: The rope was cut and the huge blades of the guillotines made their way down. Blood gushed from the prisoners' necks as their heads rolled into the baskets in front.
204.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Executions_Method_Electrocution"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Executions_Method_FiringSquad"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Executions_Method_Guillotine"] == true)

205.speaker: Narrator
205.text: The rope was cut and the wooden board beneath the prisoners' feet gave way. Some of their necks snapped immediately; others clutched at their throats, struggling for breath.
205.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Executions_Method_Electrocution"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Executions_Method_FiringSquad"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Executions_Method_Guillotine"] == true) == false)

213.speaker: Narrator
213.text: After a short while, the jerking motions of the lifeless bodies stopped.

214.speaker: Narrator
214.text: The entire plaza let out a collective gasp. Camera flashes went off. Then slowly, clapping began from the crowd.

215.speaker: Narrator
215.text: The nobles let out a collective gasp. I felt that they were looking at me in a new light. I was more feared and respected now than ever.

220.speaker: Player_Romus
220.text: "You will burn in hell for what you did to both Rizia and Wehlen."

221.speaker: Russello Montoro
221.text: "Please, Your Majesty.... I mean it. I'll do anything... Anything!"

232.speaker: Narrator
232.text: I immediately recognized the subjects of my execution order, standing alongside a number of other inmates whose time had come as well.

233.speaker: Player_Romus
233.text: "You earned my respect, only to betray me. What do you have to say for yourself?"

254.speaker: Pabel Adria
254.text: "My loyalty had its limits, Your Majesty. You found them."

255.speaker: Player_Romus
255.text: "For humiliating the Royal Family of Rizia, you will pay the ultimate price."

258.speaker: Narrator
258.text: He took a last, regretful look at me as the hood was placed back on his head.

269.speaker: Player_Romus
269.text: "To think that I trusted you with the security of me and my family."

270.speaker: Player_Romus
270.text: "You bit the hand that fed you."

273.speaker: Titus Gordion
273.text: "To think that I trusted you with leading this country."

274.speaker: Titus Gordion
274.text: "The only thing you could feed people with is poison, Your Majesty."

287.speaker: Player_Romus
287.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Executions_Hugo"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Hugo_Executed"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Hugo_Arrested"] == true

289.speaker: Player_Romus
289.text: "You are not worthy of the Toras name."

290.speaker: Player_Romus
290.text: "You were almost a father to me..."

291.speaker: Player_Romus
291.text: "May you meet my father in hell."

292.speaker: Hugo Toras
292.text: "We will wait for you to join us."

293.speaker: Hugo Toras
293.text: "Everything I ever did was for our house. But I worry it has all been for nothing."

295.speaker: Narrator
295.text: He had the look of a broken man. He lowered his eyes and said no more.

362.speaker: Player_Romus
362.text: "Fitting, isn't it? For you and your failure of a son to die together."

363.speaker: Hugo Toras
363.text: "I beg you, Romus. Kill me if you must, but spare my boy..."

377.speaker: Player_Romus
377.text: "I gave you a chance to redeem yourself, and you abused it. Your punishment is well earned."

378.speaker: Player_Romus
378.text: "My father should have done this years ago."

379.speaker: Player_Romus
379.text: "How fitting for you to die alongside your son. Your treacherous legacy ends today."

383.speaker: Player_Romus
383.text: "A pity you couldn't fall in line like your son did. Your treachery ends today."

385.speaker: Angelica Sazon
385.text: "This is not the end of House Sazon. Rizia's noblest family will survive the tyranny of Romus Toras."

388.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
388.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Adarfo_Executed"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Adarfo_Arrested"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Executions_Adarfo"] == false

389.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
389.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Adarfo_Executed"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Adarfo_Arrested"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Executions_Adarfo"] == false) == false

390.speaker: Player_Romus
390.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Adarfo_Executed"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Adarfo_Arrested"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Executions_Adarfo"] == false

392.speaker: Player_Romus
392.text: "You're a sham. You never truly wanted to make people's lives better. You only wanted to seize power."

393.speaker: Player_Romus
393.text: "Your revolution has failed, like so many others before it."

394.speaker: Player_Romus
394.text: "This is your last chance. Acknowledge me as your rightful king, and I'll clear you of all charges."

395.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
395.text: "You don't mean that. But even if you did, I would gladly accept death before bowing to you."

396.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
396.text: "It lives on in the hearts of the Rizian people. One day -- sooner than you think -- they will have their vengeance."

397.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
397.text: "I cannot take these words seriously coming from an absolute monarch."

412.speaker: Player_Romus
412.text: "Look over there at your daughter. The all-powerful House of Azaro has been reduced to nothing."

413.speaker: Narrator
413.text: His eyes filled with tears. He moved his lips, but no words came out.

417.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
417.text: "Your hubris will be your downfall. House Azaro will not go down that easily."

418.speaker: Narrator
418.text: He tried to project defiance, but there was defeat in his eyes.
